headline: A 2013 executive order directs the federal government to prepare for the effects of climate change.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Obama, deals with how the United States gets ready for the impacts of climate change. Based on its title, it focuses on preparation and planning rather than on cutting emissions. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, programs, and deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: As an executive order, it mainly gives instructions to parts of the federal government about preparing for climate change impacts.

when_it_takes_effect: 2013-11-01 (date signed; executive orders usually take effect when signed)
